text: DEFONEOS — Attorney General's Office Legal Oversight AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for AGO legal oversight, prosecution decisions, and government legal advice systems. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × AGO × Legal Oversight × CPS × SFO Attorney General's Office Legal Oversight AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Attorney General's Office — covering Crown Prosecution Service, Serious Fraud Office, Government Legal Department, Treasury Devil, and public interest litigation across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Prosecution 1. Crown Prosecution Service CPS caseload 500K+ cases/year, charging decisions, case preparation, magistrates' court prosecution. Evidential test and public interest test application, victim and witness care, and Youth Court specialist prosecution. Fraud 2. Serious Fraud Office Complex fraud and bribery investigations, Deferred Prosecution Agreements, Section 2 powers, international mutual legal assistance. Corporate criminal liability, Bribery Act 2010 enforcement, and proceeds of crime recovery. Legal 3. Government Legal Department Legal advice to government departments, litigation conduct, parliamentary counsel drafting. GLD provides legal services across 25+ government departments with 2,000+ lawyers. Advocacy 4. Treasury Devil & Government Advocacy First Treasury Counsel, Government Legal Department advocates, Crown court and appellate advocacy. Treasury Devil opinion on sensitive government litigation, and Attorney General's reference on points of law. Interest 5. Public Interest Litigation Attorney General's fiat, relator proceedings, charities regulation, contempt of court. Public interest immunity certificates, closed material proceedings, and inquests with national security implications. Oversight 6. Legal Oversight & Ethics Law Officers' superintendence of CPS and SFO, referral of unduly lenient sentences, Attorney General's consent for prosecutions. Legal professional privilege, ethics advisory, and government lawyering standards. International 7. International Legal Matters International Court of Justice, International Criminal Court cooperation, mutual legal assistance treaties, extradition. Sovereign immunity, diplomatic immunity opinions, and treaty implementation. National Security 8. National Security Law Terrorism prosecution consent, state secrets, closed proceedings, special advocates. TPIMs, passport confiscation, citizenship deprivation legal oversight, and national security court management. Charities 9. Charity Law & Regulation Charity Commission oversight, charitable trust cy-près, charity dissolution, Attorney General's role in charity proceedings. Public benefit guidance, fundraising regulation, and trustee disqualification. Data 10. Legal Data & Disclosure Criminal Procedure & Investigations Act disclosure, unused material management, digital evidence handling. Body-worn video, digital forensic evidence, and sensitive material scheduling. Inquests 11. Inquests & Public Inquiries Coronial law oversight, Article 2 ECHR inquests, public inquiry legal framework. Hillsborough, Grenfell, Infected Blood inquiry legal coordination. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability Attorney General's Questions, Law Officers' Convention, legal privilege in government. Written ministerial statements on legal matters, NAO legal spend audits, and Justice Committee oversight. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 CPS Charging Decision AI Charging decision time 28d→7d, evidential test accuracy +35%. AI-assisted evidence review, case file quality assessment, and public interest test weighting. Target: 90% of straightforward charging decisions within 7 days. Priority 2 SFO Investigation Intelligence Case building time 3yr→18mo, financial flow trac
